web.installCommand: root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd); cd "$root" && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --filter @idlebot/web...
web.buildCommand: root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd); cd "$root" && VITE_USE_API=1 pnpm --filter @idlebot/web build

api.installCommand: root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd); cd "$root" && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --filter @idlebot/api...
api.buildCommand: root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd); cd "$root" && pnpm --filter @idlebot/api build
